rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when someone is in charge or gets to make the decisions, including in a relationship.

example.english: I usually let my wife rule on the big decisions at home.
example.traditional: 屋企大事通常都係我老婆話事。
example.jyutping: uk1 kei2 daai6 si6 tung1 soeng4 dou1 hai6 ngo5 lou5 po4 waa6 si6

rows.note: Use this for regulating, managing, or running an organisation, system, or area rather than stressing personal authority.

example.english: The district council manages the whole park instead of letting one person rule.
example.traditional: 區議會管理成個公園，唔會由一個人話事。
example.jyutping: keoi1 ji5 wui6 gun2 lei5 seng4 go3 gung1 jyun4 m4 wui5 jau4 jat1 go3 jan4 waa6 si6

rows.note: Use this specifically for a ruler or government ruling a country, territory, or people.

example.english: This dynasty went on to rule this land for hundreds of years.
example.traditional: 呢個皇朝統治咗呢片土地幾百年。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 wong4 ciu4 tung2 zi6 zo2 ni1 pin3 tou2 dei6 gei2 baak3 nin4

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an explicit rule, regulation, or guideline.

example.english: The rule here is that smoking indoors isn't allowed.
example.traditional: 呢度嘅規則係唔准喺室內吸煙。
example.jyutping: ni1 dou6 ge3 gwai1 zak1 hai6 m4 zeon2 hai2 sat1 noi6 kap1 jin1

rows.note: Use this for an established usual practice rather than an imposed regulation.

example.english: The rule at our company is that new colleagues treat everyone to coffee on their first day.
example.traditional: 公司嘅慣例係新同事第一日要請大家飲咖啡。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 ge3 gwaan3 lai6 hai6 san1 tung4 si6 dai6 jat1 jat6 jiu3 ceng2 daai6 gaa1 jam2 gaa3 fe1

rows.note: Use this for a general principle that guides what is considered right or appropriate.

example.english: My rule is never to lie to people.
example.traditional: 我做嘢嘅原則係唔呃人。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zou6 je5 ge3 jyun4 zak1 hai6 m4 aak1 jan4

rows.note: Use this for the prescribed way or procedure for carrying out a particular operation.

example.english: The rule for cooking this dish is simple: add oil first, then garlic.
example.traditional: 煮呢味餸嘅做法好簡單，先落油再落蒜。
example.jyutping: zyu2 ni1 mei6 sung3 ge3 zou6 faat3 hou2 gaan2 daan1 sin1 lok6 jau4 zoi3 lok6 syun3
